title: Bombardment of Beirut (1840)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Bombardment of Beirut (1840)", at revision 1370605019, opens: "The bombardment of Beirut (1840) was a battle during the Egyptian–Ottoman War (1839–1841). It ended in an Allied victory and the city was captured." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q114450530, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1840 bombardment". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
